summary: VerifyMe, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a second amendment to its Agreement and Plan of Merger with Open World Ltd. The amendment revises the definition of Fully Diluted Company Shares to include ordinary shares issuable under existing equity agreements. The transaction is a merger where Merger Sub will merge into Open World, making Open World a wholly-owned subsidiary of VerifyMe. The filing references a Registration Statement on Form S-4/A filed June 8, 2026. No financial terms, premiums, or advisors are disclosed. The regulatory clock and risk-arb angle depend on future shareholder approval and SEC clearance for the S-4.
